items.mainDefect: The add/remove member routes are declared as bare routes inside `resources :groups`, so they produce `/admin/groups/members` with no id segment and never match the client's `/admin/groups/<id>/members.json` URL.

secondary.defect: The controller actions read the group id with `params.require(:group_id)`, but the route never supplies that parameter, so the param name and the route don't agree.
